official_definition: You can put any number of cores from your Reserve/Field to a "Scarlet Flame" family Spirit/Nexus you control. (Once per Turn: Same Name) When cores are put via this effect, your counter +1. Also, if it's your Attack Step, your counter +1.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Toppa Awaken] or [Toppa Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Toppa Awaken]", "give [Toppa Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
